title: AI models and costs
summary: The author's own OpenRouter key, their choice of model, and what it costs.

stories.as: an author paying for my own AI usage
stories.want: to see what the assistant costs me
stories.soThat: I can choose a cheaper model where it does just as well

requirements.text: Model calls go to OpenRouter with an API key the author supplies.
The OpenRouter key and model choice sync to the book's devices like other settings.
The model list is fetched live from OpenRouter, shown from a cache until the fetch returns.
Every model response that reports its cost is recorded in a usage ledger under the feature that made it.
The app shows AI spend in total, by feature, by model and over time.
Book content is sent to no third party but OpenRouter, for the model the author chose.

Every model request names the most its answer may run to, by what it's for (`ai.most-answer.*`), so OpenRouter holds back no more of the author's credit than that while it answers. An answer cut off there says so rather than passing for whole.

values.description: The most an answer may run to: a round of the assistant's answer, its thinking included.
The most an answer may run to: the details a model reads of a library item.
The most an answer may run to: a recording's script: a passage put into speech, or a whole summary.
The most an answer may run to: the answer to the key's test in Settings.
